sloka: विरूपाक्षश्च दुर्धर्षो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ ।अकम्पनश्च निहतो बलिनो ऽन्ये च राक्षसाः ।। ६.१२६.९ ।।
transliteration: virūpākṣaśca durdharṣo mahāpārśvamahodarau ।akampanaśca nihato balino 'nye ca rākṣasāḥ ।। 6.126.9 ।।

translations.english: "There is the Rakshasa by name Vikata killed by Angada, and Virupaksha (killed by Sugriva), Mahaparsva (killed by Rshaba), Mahodara (killed by Neela), Akampana and other Rakshasas, like Trisira killed by the mighty Hanuman and Atikaya by Lakshmana and Devanthaka (by Hanuman), and Naranthaka (by Angada)."
translations.hindi: युद्ध मै पराक्रम प्रदर्शित करने वाले और सदा हितयुक्त परासशै ( सलाह देने वाले सुग्रीव का तथा उनकी सेना का भी सारः परिश्रम आज सफल हुआ
